source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test waits for message.isRead, then separately clears selection and waits for the pane to show about:blank. The original readiness check uses contentDocument.readyState; accepted later code checks that the pane is no longer loading and has the blank URI. The two explicit 500 ms workarounds remain scoped test exceptions with leak-related comments. Read state alone is not document unload, and a fixed delay is not a general loading guarantee. No leak or browser test ran.
title: Read-state and unloaded message-pane readiness are separate test conditions
